Subject: RFP bake-off: ask for evaluation credits + onboarding window

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Acme Labs is running a two-week side-by-side evaluation as part of our RFP; we expect heavy throughput for the first 5 business days while we exercise prompts and retrain scoring nets. Can Redwood provide a timeboxed evaluation voucher (credits + sandbox access) scoped to the RFP so we can run parallel comparisons?

Specifically we'd like:
- 5M token credit for model inference (ideally GPU-backed variants)
- Sandbox project with isolated data retention (14-day retention) and access to token-level latency logs
- One onboarding session (2 hrs) to walk our engineers through the API, streaming, and model fallback behavior

We also have a checklist from procurement; attaching the RFP scoping doc. Procurement will want to confirm usage caps and any gating for marketplace billing.

Can you confirm what an expedited onboarding + credit flow would look like and any required paperwork? We aim to kick off the eval on Jan 11.

Best,

- Approver: can we approve a 5M token voucher from the trial budget (sales incentives pool) for this RFP?

Thanks Ben — quick takes:

Budget/approval
- We have precedence to grant up to 6M tokens for competitive bake-offs from the eval subsidy pool; approving 5M is fine but include a usage escalation clause (auto-throttle at 80%).

Ops
- Sandbox can be provisioned in our US staging region with 14-day retention; will provide daily latency CSVs and a prefixed KV cache snapshot. SRE asks we mark the sandbox as "non-prod" and enable request-level sampling (1%) for detailed traces — this keeps overhead low.

Legal
- Procurement should sign a short "Eval Acknowledgement" (one page) referencing: data retention, no PII ingestion, temporary credentials expiration, and indemnity clause limited to eval scope. I can get this from legal and fast-track it.

Onboarding
- I'll schedule a 90-minute tech walkthrough first (API + streaming + model-switch behaviors) and then a 30-minute follow-up Q&A during their burst window. Ops will hand off sandbox creds in the morning of the kickoff.

Attachments: sandbox-credentials.csv (will be provisioned once ack received)

Kim
Sales Operations Lead | Redwood Inference

Hi Alice — happy to confirm next steps and the approved package for Acme's RFP bake-off. Summary below (finalized):

What we will provide
- Evaluation voucher: 5,000,000 token credit (GPU-backed profile). Expires 21 days from activation.
- Sandbox: isolated project in US-staging with 14-day retention. Includes daily token-latency CSV export and a prefixed KV snapshot.
- Onboarding: 90-minute technical walkthrough + 30-minute Q&A during the first business window.

Operational controls
- Auto-throttle: usage will throttle at 80% of the voucher; ops will notify Acme and provide a one-time temporary uplift if needed (subject to approval).
- Sampling: request-level 1% tracing enabled for detailed latency/trace exports. No deep inspection of payloads; customers must avoid PII ingestion per the Eval Acknowledgement.

Legal & procurement
- Please review and sign the attached one-page Eval Acknowledgement. This covers the timebox, data retention, and limited liability for the eval. Once signed, ops will provision the sandbox and deliver the credentials.

Attachments: Eval_Acknowledgement-Acme.pdf (one-page)

Proposed timeline
- Jan 6: Procurement signs Eval Acknowledgement
- Jan 7 (AM): Sandbox credentials delivered, onboarding scheduled Jan 11 (90-min walkthrough)
- Jan 11–Jan 31: Eval window (up to 21 days once voucher activated)

If that all sounds good I'll send the DocuSign link for the Eval Acknowledgement and finalize the onboarding slot.

Thanks — looking forward to the bake-off.
